criteria.reason: Finite ordered component family, global pair quantification and zero-distance equivalence are explicit. Effective-domain alternative is clearly separated at the end.

Joint nonnegative extended matrix upper certificates have correct output-row orientation, monotonicity and composition order. Infinity imposes no finite bound on a positive input component but still annihilates zero.

Forward lower matrices are explicitly selected, zero is always valid, positive columns imply zero-distance reflection rather than ordinary injectivity. Reverse-control matrices are not falsely equated to inverses.

Certificate existence iff total zero-distance preservation is proved via the all-infinity matrix. The zero-distance counterexample is valid. Duplicate component matrices disprove least upper/greatest lower certificates. Infinite-distance identity gives nonattainment of scalar infimum0.

The infimum over bad-pair distances exactly characterizes strict thresholds r<=C, including0 and infinity. Strict rather than closed thresholds make the endpoint valid. Infinity covers finite input distances only. Boolean zero-preservation and the propagation inequalities are correctly proved.

Relations among lower control, upper propagation and collapse are compatible with the definitions. Equation8 is justified by a finite maximum over component indices. The three-point example has upper1, lower0 and collapse threshold2, with the boundary explicitly failing.

scope: 上/下矩阵可行集方向和复合顺序正确，0∞算术处理一致；证明上界可行恰等价于保持全分量零距，并给无证书反例，未把∞说成普遍存在性。最优矩阵不存在/inf不取到反例正确。坏点距离inf定义严格阈值，含0/∞边界；布尔零距矩阵与其复合、阈值传播及三点例子均可核验。
